calls.reason: The only restriction in evidence is the DHS order on DeepSeek, which covers federal procurement only. CRS says it does not restrict private use, so no commercial moat exists whose effects could be judged.

CRS confirms that only federal procurement of DeepSeek was restricted. No general US ban on Chinese models took effect, so the forecast's condition was never met and there are no price or innovation effects to judge.

Ars Technica's report on audited accounts confirms OpenAI's 2025 net loss. But nothing shows that a missing technical moat caused it, and the reported causes are R&D and accounting charges.
